name: Free and Independent State of Cundinamarca
native: Estado Libre e Independiente de Cundinamarca
wikipedia: Free and Independent State of Cundinamarca

predecessors.name: Spanish Empire
predecessors.text: the Province of Bogotá around the capital, 'the former capital of the Viceroyalty of New Granada'

successors.name: United Provinces of New Granada
successors.text: Cundinamarca, brought into the Union by Bolívar's army in December 1814 (page), and the plains the 1815 shape adds

rulers.name: Antonio Nariño
rulers.title: President, dictator for life from June 1813

ledger.x: March 1811: Cundinamarca sets up its government.
July 1813: Cundinamarca declares independence from the Monarchy.
May 1814: Nariño is defeated at Pasto, arrested and sent to Cádiz via Quito, ending the southern campaign.
December 1814: Bolívar forces Cundinamarca to terms.
December 1814: Cundinamarca is annexed by the United Provinces.
December 1814: the Free and Independent State of Cundinamarca ends in the Union of the United Provinces of New Granada.

wars.name: Civil war between Cundinamarca and the United Provinces of New Granada
wars.outcome: Nariño lost at Ventaquemada (2 December 1812) and the federalists lost at San Victorino (9 January 1813); in December 1814 Bolívar forced Bogotá to terms and the state was annexed.

wars.name: Nariño's southern campaign
wars.outcome: Popayán captured in January 1814; Nariño defeated at Pasto in May 1814, arrested and sent to Cádiz.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey fixes the State's limits; the page gives 'parts of the former New Kingdom of Granada'.

sources.title: Free and Independent State of Cundinamarca
